findings.where: §12.5 BUNDLE_FETCH_ARGS paragraph and step 3, §9.13 step 2, §7.3 artifacts dir (ossbox:ossart 0750)
findings.title: Gatekeeper bundle fetch with the scoped protocol.file.allow=always reads in place from an ossbox-writable directory; a post-sha256 swap of change.bundle for a directory would make git treat it as a local repo (upload-pack with attacker repo config). No known code-exec key and integrity is preserved by mirror derivation, so hardening only
findings.fix: Open the source with O_NOFOLLOW, require S_ISREG and size <= 50 MB, copy into gatekeeper-private /srv/ossbot/gatekeeper/work/<cid>-r<rev>.bundle (0600), sha256 the copy, run list-heads/verify/fetch only on the copy; add --no-recurse-submodules to the gatekeeper, unbundle.sh and package.sh fetches; test: a directory at the artifact path -> 422 bundle_invalid

findings.where: §15.4 install script and 'Install hygiene' paragraph, §15.2 probe triggers, §27.0a R4-N4
findings.title: A hermes-uid process can still start during the upgrade swap window (hourly/on-demand hermes-probe runs the hermes-writable kiro-cli via runuser; ossctl hermes login), and the rollback branch has no pgrep re-check, so 'refuse_link checks cannot be raced' is overstated
findings.fix: provision.sh holds flock /run/ossbot/hermes-upgrade.lock for the whole step and stops ossbot-hermes-probe.socket; hermes_probe and ossctl hermes login take the lock non-blocking (probe inconclusive 'Hermes is upgrading', no kill); repeat the pgrep -u hermes refusal after the rollback pkill; add a mid-upgrade probe-trigger case to test_hermes_install_hygiene.sh

findings.title: Importing kiro_acp.v3_core executes kiro_acp/__init__.py (typically the Hermes provider registration), and how the vendor tree reaches root's sys.path under python -I is unstated; fails closed, but is an implementability gap
findings.fix: Keep kiro_acp/__init__.py import-free and move Hermes registration to kiro_acp/hermes_plugin.py named by the plugin manifest; declare vendor/hermes-kiro-provider as a non-editable uv path dependency of the app so it installs into /opt/ossbot/app/.venv; extend test_hermes_probe_paths.py: kiro_acp.__file__ under /opt/ossbot and importing v3_core loads only stdlib/ossbot/kiro_acp modules
